usa_adm1.name: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

census_identity.vintages: The retained Census joins cover 2018 and 2021 records; the 69085/GEOID and county namespace are unchanged across them.
census_identity.incidence_limit: 203 ADM1 plus 150 ADM2 equals 353 source incidences, with overlap; these are not 353 unique cells. Census identity/name/identifier corroboration is not polygon equality, source adoption, owner assignment, or a legal sovereignty determination.
census_identity.decision: Yes: the exact official state-69 parent and county-085/GEOID-69085 Northern Islands records support the narrow contextual treatment of these exact original USA contact operands. The state record is parent-jurisdiction context for the enumerated Tinian, Rota, and Northern Islands cells; the county record corroborates the same Northern Islands Municipality identity for only the Northern Islands contacts. This is an identity/context interpretation, not an independent ownership or exclusion result. All original source geometries remain present in the negative/contact evidence, and exact native-key, source-membership, physical, and selected-owner predicates remain separately required. No specific identity contradiction was found between the Census records and the recorded MNP names; the separate same-release full-source misses and the Northern Islands physical land/water issue remain adverse.

predicates: The positive target id binds to a selected current target; its pixelIndex is a positive native owner index.
The physical stage binds the target's whole consumed original source geometry and shapeID, plus selected target id and exact selected base geometry.
Negative families are an explicit, unique reviewed list of whole original catalogue products; names, prefixes, or absent owner fields do not infer foreign status or applicability.

For each target, a candidate negative is retained only when complete source-member and feature bounds touch/intersect. Only bbox-disjoint features are omitted; retained geometries remain whole and source_id/feature ordinal/geometry hash are preserved.

Compact references bind source_id, feature_ordinal, negative_ordinal and geometry_sha256; ambiguous or unmatched geometry remains literal. Native reader expands exact complete original geometry before existing applicability/veto checks.
The code explicitly says this preparation does not derive positive ownership or an applicability exception; native source, owner, physical, geometry and full-scope qualification remain required.

narrow_adoption_statement: The exact Census state-69 ADM1 feature is supportable as a parent-jurisdiction context reference for the MNP targets, and Census ADM2 GEOID 69085/COUNTYNS 01805245 is supportable as same-entity identity corroboration for the Northern Islands Municipality contact. This specific interpretation is justified by the exact Census name/identifier hierarchy join; it must not be generalized to exclude all USA-labeled sources or to treat these features as replacement positive geometries. Preserve the two complete source operands and every recorded contact; keep per-key native effects separate.

The MNP original simplified source matches all 205 keys, while the same-release full MNP source matches 202 and misses 3; all three adverse keys remain explicit and require separate treatment.
